title: SEC0: Send failure loses pending attachments
description:
File: /home/mark/WORK/KITH/web/app.js:653-659

Bug: In sendMessage() error path, pendingAttachments are cleared before the JMAP call (line 593), but on send failure (lines 653-659), the user's selected files are not restored. This causes silent data loss: if the user selects files, clicks send, and the send fails, the attachments vanish from the compose area without warning.

Fix: In the catch block (line 653), after restoring textarea.value, restore the attachments: 'pendingAttachments = attachmentsSnapshot; renderAttachmentPreview();'
